title: The Unstructured "Spew" Smell
pattern: Ad-hoc, inconsistent formatting of text log messages describing identical operations across different modules.
why_bad: Unstructured, inconsistent spew defeats the pattern-matching capability of log aggregators, makes regex-based scraping highly brittle, and slows down triaging during active incidents [208, 654, 695].
detection: Different string format structures used across logging macros mapping to equivalent runtime event types.
fix: Standardize on structured key-value log attributes using consistent fields across the codebase.
